draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 210th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 20th of 24 at DE. He went 230th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (91st percentile), vertical jump (99th percentile), broad jump (100th percentile). College production: 2 sacks in 2018, 24th of 24 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 34 career games and 3 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-7 edge rusher who played: 0.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
